figures.name: Layer Stack
figures.alt: Three map sheets stacked above one another: a field of data points, the road network, and the finished map with a river, a park and a route between two pins.

figures.name: Rush Hour
figures.alt: A two-lane road in a jam: two cars stopped nose to tail in each lane, the road empty behind them.

figures.name: Hazard Ahead
figures.alt: A car broken down askew in its lane on a two-lane road, a traffic cone behind it and smoke rising off its bonnet.

figures.name: Lens and Pin
figures.alt: A magnifying glass held over a street map, with a map pin rising up through the lens.

figures.name: Live Streets
figures.alt: A map tile with a connected network of roads, low buildings, and traffic dashes on the main road.

figures.name: Ask the Way
figures.alt: A chat bubble whose tail is a map pin, standing on a street map, with an AI spark at its corner and a dashed route to a destination.

figures.name: Ask for Places
figures.alt: A chat bubble whose tail is a map pin, standing on a street map, with an AI spark at its corner and map pins rising from places, one of them chosen.

figures.name: Connected Globe
figures.alt: A globe with service points on it, linked by arcs to one hub, and two AI sparks beside it.

figures.name: Dotted Earth
figures.alt: A globe whose continents are drawn in fine dots, Europe and Africa facing the viewer, a scatter of dots on the land lit where data is coming in.

figures.name: Dropped Pin
figures.alt: A map marker, a pin with a round hole through its head, hovering over a round pad, the spot it marks.

figures.name: Tile Service
figures.alt: A grid of map tiles with one missing, a server just above the empty slot, linked to two other services.

figures.name: Round the Corner
figures.alt: A car on a street map seen from above, with a route round the corner to a destination pin.

figures.name: Modular Cockpit
figures.alt: A tablet lying on a table, its interface built of modules set into slots: a map with a route from a chevron to a pin, lane guidance and a trip panel.

figures.name: Probable Path
figures.alt: A car in the middle lane of a three-lane road, faint sensor arcs at its front corners, and ahead of it the lane it will most likely take picked out with a row of chevrons.

figures.name: Free Bay
figures.alt: A car parked in its bay, and beside it a free bay with a parking marker, a P, floating over it.

figures.name: Load Order
figures.alt: A delivery van with its back doors open and three parcels queued behind it, each marked with dots for its stop, their order shuffling as dispatch updates it.

figures.name: Route Drawn
figures.alt: Two roads from a start point to a destination pin, the chosen one raised with the pin and the route drawn along it.

figures.name: Route Matrix
figures.alt: A street grid with two origins on one side, each routed along the streets to two stop pins of its own, the first origin's routes lit.

figures.name: Pocket Navigator
figures.alt: A phone lying screen up with a navigation app: a route runs along the map's streets from a position puck to a destination pin.

figures.name: Lap Replay
figures.alt: A map with a park and its pines, and a run along the street round it, the runner a puck and the stretch already run lit.

figures.name: Corner Shop
figures.alt: A shop on a street corner with a map pin over its roof.

figures.name: Charge Point
figures.alt: A lightning bolt hovering over a round charging pad.

figures.name: Depot Belt
figures.alt: Crates leaving a depot along a belt in stop order.

figures.name: Heat Sun
figures.alt: A sun with its rays reaching out.

figures.name: Long Haul
figures.alt: A car on a road from start to destination pin, with a charger halfway.

figures.name: Walking Ring
figures.alt: A home inside a walking ring, with a bus stop, a park and a shop around it.

figures.name: Doorstep
figures.alt: A parcel on the path to a front door.

figures.name: Two Roads
figures.alt: Two roads from a start point to a destination pin, one raised.

figures.name: Shared Bay
figures.alt: A small car and a bike parked nose to tail in a shared bay.

figures.name: Geofence
figures.alt: A delivery truck inside its geofence, with sonar rings around it.

figures.name: Neighbourhood Moods
figures.alt: Three faces standing on a street map, one per neighbourhood: happy, so-so and sad.

figures.name: Pull Out
figures.alt: A queue of cars nose to tail on a short road.

figures.name: Sky Fix
figures.alt: A round position puck on a small street patch with an accuracy ring around it, and three small satellites with solar panels above, dashed lines running from one of them down to the puck.

figures.name: Saved Region
figures.alt: A shallow open drawer with a finger pull, and above it a map region split into nine thin tiles; one corner tile already sits inside the drawer.

figures.name: Rolling Road
figures.alt: A car standing on a belt that runs round two rollers on a floor plate, with a round cooling fan on a stand in front of its nose.

figures.name: Push Keys
figures.alt: A slim rounded panel with four round push buttons in a row; the third is pressed in, with a bright rim and centre dot.

figures.name: Next Turn
figures.alt: A four-way crossroads with a raised route ribbon coming up the near road and curving right into the far-right road.

figures.name: Lane Gantry
figures.alt: A straight three-lane road crossed by a sign gantry with a panel over each lane; the middle panel is swung out and its lane stripe is lit.

figures.name: Trip Rail
figures.alt: A long slim rail with a round puck on it; along its side stand a short queue of cars, a map pin and a charging post, the pin drawn bright.

figures.name: Heads Up
figures.alt: A car driving away up a road, seen from behind and to its left, with a small pane floating just ahead of its windscreen showing a bright little road that curves into the bend.

figures.name: Arrival Dial
figures.alt: A short road from a round start puck to a clock dial on a post, with a small puck on the road as the car and the road behind it drawn bright.

figures.name: Through the Wheel
figures.alt: A car dashboard with an instrument pod under a curved hood: two round gauges with needles and a small screen showing a short route between them, seen through a three-spoke steering wheel.

figures.name: Charge Ahead
figures.alt: A battery pack with five raised cells beside a road that runs from a start puck past a charging post to a map pin; three cells are full.

figures.name: Road Profile
figures.alt: An S-curved road with a dashed centre line and, above it on dashed posts, a narrow ribbon that follows its bends and rises and falls, one stretch lit with a line dropping to the road.

figures.name: Snap Line
figures.for: Snap to Roads and map-matched location
figures.alt: A gently curving road with faint GPS dots scattered either side; near the start a few dots sit on the road, joined by a bright line.

figures.name: Black Box
figures.alt: A small rounded recorder case with a handle, a strip of paper curling out of its slot along the ground, and five event dots on stems above it, one lit.

figures.name: Measured Car
figures.alt: A car framed by dashed dimension lines with end ticks along its side, across its front and standing at its rear; the length line is lit.

figures.name: Day Night Tile
figures.alt: A map tile held between two posts on a low base, leaning toward the viewer, with streets, a river and a park on top; turned over, its underside shows the same streets lined with dots for street lights.

figures.name: Camera Orbit
figures.alt: A small camera with a lens rides a curved rail arching over a map tile, its lens turned on the tile.

figures.name: Map Print
figures.alt: A server box with vents and a status light, a map sheet with streets, a river and a park sliding out of a slot in its front like a print.

figures.name: Open Sign
figures.for: POI details: contact and opening hours
figures.alt: A flat-roofed shop with a wide window and a door, a sign plate hanging from a bracket at its corner; near the pointer the plate turns to show a clock face and the door is outlined bright.

figures.name: Request Deck
figures.alt: Six thin cards standing in a tray, each with a different route line on it; the card under the pointer stands up with its route bright while the others lean away.

figures.name: Toll Gate
figures.alt: A short road with a small roofed toll booth on an island beside it and a barrier arm across the lane; as the pointer nears, the arm swings up.

figures.name: Detour
figures.alt: A street plan of three low blocks with a roadworks barrier across the main road; near the barrier the route bends off up a cross street, round the middle block and back down.

figures.name: Speaker Grille
figures.alt: A car door panel with a pull slot and a round speaker set low in it: a raised rim with screws around a grille of dots, the dots near the pointer pushed out.

figures.name: Speed Camera
figures.alt: A straight road with a dashed centre line, a camera box on a post at its far end facing oncoming traffic, a barred zone strip on the road before it, and a round car puck.

figures.name: Pause Point
figures.alt: A winding route from a round start puck to a map pin, with a notched bookmark on a short stem standing partway along it; the route behind it is bright, the route ahead dashed.

figures.name: Limit Ring
figures.alt: A large round sign with a broad ring and a blank centre on a tall post beside a road, a car puck on the road, and part of the sign's rim lit.

figures.name: Type Ahead
figures.alt: A search bar standing like a screen, a pill-shaped field with a caret and a round button, with three suggestion bars under it; one slides out toward the viewer.

figures.name: Radius Sweep
figures.alt: A round position puck with a search ring on the ground and eight map pins around it; the pins inside the ring float up on dashed lines.

figures.name: Roadside Finds
figures.alt: A road with one bend inside a dashed corridor; map pins stand along it, and those in the corridor near the pointer rise while dim pins outside stay put.

figures.name: Pin to Door
figures.alt: Three gabled houses in a row with a map pin overhead; the pin settles over the house under the pointer and its door and door plate light up.

figures.name: Relief Tile
figures.alt: A square terrain tile on a thin plinth, its surface cut into parallel strips that follow two ridges and a valley, with a dot on the rim marking the sun.

figures.name: Sensor Stack
figures.alt: A position puck on the ground, linked to three sensors on round plinths behind it: a dish, an upright wheel and a gyroscope.

figures.name: Head Unit
figures.alt: A car dashboard with a steering wheel, a wide head-unit screen and a phone in a cradle showing a route, joined by a cable.

figures.name: Open Sockets
figures.alt: A charging post with a small screen and three round sockets; the middle one has a plug in it, its cable lying in a loop beside the post.

figures.name: Plug Fit
figures.alt: A round charging plug, flattened on one side and turned off-angle, hovering on its cable above a matching socket with five pin holes.

figures.name: Pocket Route
figures.alt: An open drawer holding one map tile; a route steps across the tile from a start dot to an end dot.

figures.name: Patch Tile
figures.alt: A three-by-three grid of map tiles; one tile is lifted out and a fresh tile with a new street drops into its slot.

figures.name: Token Blocks
figures.alt: A navigation panel beside a tray of four small blocks; one block is lifted and the panel part it controls is outlined.

figures.name: Route Sleeve
figures.alt: A thin map card half inside a folder sleeve with a thumb cut; pulled out, a route with two end dots is drawn across it.
